# `aitbc genesis info`

Show the genesis block information for a chain.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc genesis info [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to show info for (auto-detected from blockchain node if not provided) |
| `--data-dir` | text | — | no | Data directory path (default: /var/lib/aitbc/data) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL for chain ID auto-detection (default: http://localhost:8202) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc genesis info
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc genesis info --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
